appetizers.name: Chalupas Poblanas
appetizers.description: Small, fried corn tortillas lightly topped with shredded pork, finely chopped onions, and a choice of traditional red or green salsa. A classic Puebla street food staple.

appetizers.name: Molotes
appetizers.description: Crispy, oval-shaped corn masa pastries stuffed with seasoned shredded chicken or potatoes, deep-fried to perfection, and drizzled with Mexican cream and crumbled fresh cheese.

appetizers.name: Cemita Poblana (Sliders)
appetizers.description: Mini versions of Puebla’s iconic sandwich, made with artisanal sesame-seeded bread, filled with breaded beef milanesa, avocado, quesillo (string cheese), and aromatic pápalo leaves.

appetizers.name: Sopa Poblana
appetizers.description: A comforting, creamy soup made from roasted Poblano peppers, sweet corn kernels, and tender zucchini blossoms, garnished with a touch of panela cheese.

main_courses.name: Mole Poblano
main_courses.description: The crown jewel of Puebla. Tender chicken breast smothered in our rich, dark, artisanal mole sauce made from a blend of chilies, nuts, spices, and Mexican chocolate, sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds.

main_courses.name: Chiles en Nogada
main_courses.description: A majestic Poblano pepper stuffed with a savory-sweet mixture of minced pork, fruits, and nuts, topped with a creamy walnut sauce (nogada) and bright red pomegranate seeds.

main_courses.name: Pipian Verde
main_courses.description: Succulent pork shoulder simmered in a vibrant, savory green sauce made from toasted pumpkin seeds (pepitas), green tomatoes, chilies, and fresh cilantro.

main_courses.name: Enmoladas
main_courses.description: Three lightly fried corn tortillas folded and drenched in our signature house mole Poblano, filled with shredded chicken, and topped with fresh onion rings and crumbled cheese.

desserts.name: Tortitas de Santa Clara
desserts.description: Traditional shortbread cookies native to Puebla, featuring a round, dual-textured crust filled with a sweet, smooth glaze made from pepita (pumpkin seed) paste.

desserts.name: Camotes Poblanos
desserts.description: Authentic, soft sweet potato candy cylinders flavored with natural extracts of strawberry and vanilla. A historic convent recipe from Puebla.

desserts.name: Flan Casero de Vainilla
desserts.description: A rich, velvety baked custard infused with aromatic Mexican vanilla bean, drenched in a sweet, golden liquid caramel sauce.

desserts.name: Molletes Poblanos (Dessert Style)
desserts.description: A seasonal sweet treat consisting of a soft bread filled with custard, glazed with a delicate pink pumpkin seed frosting.

drinks.name: Agua de Chocolate y Menta
drinks.description: A refreshing, chilled water infused with premium Mexican cacao and fresh mint leaves. A subtle, sweet homage to the flavors of mole.

drinks.name: Horchata con Toque de Nuez
drinks.description: A traditional, creamy milky rice drink flavored with cinnamon, with a special Puebla twist of finely crushed pecans mixed in.

drinks.name: Agua de Limón con Chía
drinks.description: Crisp, ice-cold lime water lightly sweetened and packed with hydrated chia seeds for a refreshing, classic Mexican lunchtime experience.

drinks.name: Café de Olla
drinks.description: Traditional Mexican aromatic coffee brewed in a clay pot with Mexican cinnamon sticks and piloncillo (unrefined whole cane sugar).
